quests.title: Xala
quests.subtitle: Containerized app on AWS EC2 with CI/CD
points: Three-container stack (Vue 3 SPA behind Nginx, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) on a live EC2 instance with Docker Compose, security groups, and Linux server access.
GitHub Actions pipeline: pytest, Docker image build/push to Docker Hub, then EC2 redeploy via SSM Run Command using OIDC federation and a least-privilege IAM role — no static credentials.
Nginx reverse-proxies API traffic; Alembic migrations and Gemini-powered sales analytics ship with the app.

quests.title: AWS Multi-AZ HA Architecture
quests.subtitle: 3-tier high-availability design + cost model
points: Custom VPC with public/private subnets, route tables, ALB, Auto Scaling Group, Aurora Multi-AZ, least-privilege IAM, and automated backups.
Modeled a monthly cost breakdown (~$490) to weigh high availability against operating cost.

quests.title: Diagram Exporter
quests.subtitle: Transformer diagram and manufacturing-report automation
points: Python desktop app that loads toroidal transformer designs from the factory database and draws primary/secondary windings, phase dots, and thermal switches on a canvas.
Engineers edit winding specs (color, length, gauge, tubes) with live diagram updates, then drag, add, or delete components before saving a PNG.
A decoupled Excel engine fills multi-sheet reports from the same data: design page, control plan, BOM with prices, production sheet, time sheets, and front page.

quests.title: Reqaists
quests.subtitle: Local AI REST API tester
points: Reads an OpenAPI spec, builds a Pydantic model for one endpoint, and asks a local Ollama model (gemma4:e4b by default) to fill happy, edge, and invalid cases.
Run mode calls the live API, seeds ids for GET/PUT/DELETE when needed, and records pass/fail. Generate-only mode saves cases to runs/{timestamp}.json without hitting the server.
Terminal (`python -m tester`) and a FastAPI web UI on port 8080. Ships a sample Customer CRUD API on SQLite for local trials.

quests.title: CS50 Video Transcript API
quests.subtitle: FastAPI over CS50 YouTube transcripts
points: CS50P capstone REST API: paginated playlists and videos, transcripts by video id or title, SQLite plus SQLModel, pytest coverage.
